item.title: Planning application submitted for family entertainment centre in Killarney Outlet Centre
item.description: Kerry County Council have received a planning application for a family entertainment centre in Killarney Outlet Centre. The proposed development includes an eight lane bowling alley and an interactive games area. The application was submitted by Cork-based developer and owner of the Outlet Centre, COK Property Limited, in aim of addressing long-term vacancy. item.title: Minister of state claims roads funding for Kerry only secured because of Healy-Rae government support
item.description: Minister of State Michael Healy-Rae claims the level of roads funding secured for Kerry is because of Healy-Rae support for the government. Over €65 million in funding was announced yesterday for roads in Kerry. It’s part of a national €1.5 billion package announced by transport minister, Darragh O’Brien, and Transport Infrastructure Ireland. item.description: Minister for Children Norma Foley has welcomed the news that the families of children who attended North Kerry CAMHS were to receive the report this morning. The minister, who’s a Fianna Fáil TD for Kerry, says it was a matter of respect that they were to get the report first. item.title: North Kerry CAMHS report finds 56% of children put at risk of potential harm from treatment
item.description: A report has found 56% of children in the care of North Kerry CAMHS were at risk of potential harm from their treatment. The long-awaited report into the North Kerry Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service, seen by Radio Kerry will not be officially published by the HSE until this evening. Families and service users were due to receive it this morning, the report is then being presented to Cabinet this afternoon and it will be officially published after that. item.title: Health care assistants in Kerry call off tomorrow's strike after WRC deal struck
item.description: A trade union representative for health care assistants in Kerry has welcomed an WRC agreement with the HSE, averting strike action. Kerry health care assistants had been due to strike in Kerry next week (26th February), after voting in favour of industrial action in January. Local implementation and oversight groups will be established to ensure the agreement is implemented without delay. item.title: Man accused of dragging young woman into car in Listowel sent forward to stand trial
item.description: A man accused of falsely imprisoning a young woman in North Kerry has been sent forward to face trial. 22-year-old Muhammed Ahsan appeared in person before Tralee District Court where he was served with the book of evidence. He faces charges including falsely imprisoning and endangering a woman in his car in Listowel in September. item.title: Lacey Cup returns to Tralee on March 1st
item.description: The 71st edition of the Lacey Cup hosted by Tralee Manor West Bicycle Club will be held on Sunday, March 1st. As is customary, the Lacey Cup will be the grand opener to the Munster Road Racing season. The challenging 71km circuit always lends itself to aggressive racing with cyclists eager to test themselves and to show some good early season form. item.title: Real Madrid players call out racial abuse following last night's clash with Benfica
item.description: Vinicius Junior has called racists "cowards" after he was allegedly abused during Real Madrid's 1-nil win at Benfica. He briefly left the pitch after reporting Gianluca Prestianni, with the Champions League match paused for ten minutes under UEFA protocol. The Brazilian has been subjected to racism on numerous occasions during his career. Advertisement Former France defender Mikael Silvestre is an active campaigner against racism in football.

item.title: Ban on Russian athletes lifted, Ukraine officials boycott
item.description: Ukrainian officials won't attend the upcoming Winter Paralympics after the ban on Russian athletes was lifted. They'll be allowed to compete under their national flag for the first time since 2016. Organisers have granted wildcard places to six skiers and snowboarders ahead of the Games in Milan Cortina.
